title: feat(detail): iOS grouped-inset record detail on mobile
body:
**Phase 1** of the agreed **"Linear on desktop, iOS-native on mobile"** direction (premium feel + real mobile target).

`DetailSection` now renders fields as **iOS grouped-inset rows on mobile** — label left, value right, hairline dividers between rows inside the section card (the native iOS Settings/detail form). **Desktop is unchanged**: the dense multi-column grid with label-on-top is kept for scannability.

- Branch is **mobile-only** (`useIsMobile`) and **read-mode only** — inline editing falls back to the stacked layout so inputs have room.
- Zero desktop impact; low risk.

## Verified
Showcase Account 360 + Settings record pages at **390×844** (grouped-inset rows) and **1440** (unchanged dense grid). 48 detail tests pass.

> Next phases (for discussion, not in this PR): segmented controls for view switchers, a subtle/fast motion pass, surface/type refinement. This PR is the flagship to validate the look.
